+    @app.get("/api/accounts/{account_id}/statement.csv")
+    def export_statement(
+        account: OwnedAccount,
+        conn: Conn,
+        start: Annotated[date | None, Query(alias="from")] = None,
+        end: Annotated[date | None, Query(alias="to")] = None,
+    ) -> Response:
+        for value in (start, end):
+            if value is not None and not EARLIEST_DATE <= value <= LATEST_DATE:
+                raise HTTPException(400, f"dates must be between {EARLIEST_DATE} and {LATEST_DATE}")
+        end = end or datetime.now(UTC).date()
+        start = start or end - timedelta(days=STATEMENT_DAYS - 1)
+        try:
+            st = ledger.statement(conn, account.id, start, end)
+        except ledger.LedgerError as exc:
+            raise HTTPException(400, str(exc)) from None
+        out = io.StringIO()
+        writer = csv.writer(out, lineterminator="\n")
+        writer.writerow(
+            ["entry_id", "posted_at", "kind", "description", "reference", "amount", "balance"]
+        )
+        for line in st.lines:
+            writer.writerow(
+                [
+                    line.entry_id,
+                    line.posted_at,
+                    line.kind,
+                    line.description,
+                    line.reference or "",
+                    from_minor(line.amount_minor, account.currency),
+                    from_minor(line.balance_minor, account.currency),
+                ]
+            )
+        return Response(out.getvalue(), media_type="text/csv")

+def test_statement_csv_header(bank):
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    response = client.get(f"/api/accounts/{bank['eur'].id}/statement.csv?from=2026-05-01")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/csv")
+    header = response.text.splitlines()[0]
+    assert header == "entry_id,posted_at,kind,description,reference,amount,balance"
+

+def test_statement_csv_one_row_per_line(bank, at):
+    conn = ledger.open_db(bank["path"])
+    ledger.deposit(conn, bank["eur"].id, Money.of("2.50", "EUR"), at=at("2026-05-02"))
+    conn.close()
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    url = f"/api/accounts/{bank['eur'].id}/statement.csv?from=2026-05-01&to=2026-05-31"
+    rows = client.get(url).text.splitlines()[1:]
+    assert len(rows) == 2
+    assert rows[0].split(",")[-2:] == ["100.00", "100.00"]
+    assert rows[1].split(",")[-2:] == ["2.50", "102.50"]
